name: persona-expression-sheet
description: Lumiverse Spindle extension: upload custom expression art for your persona and watch it react live to your messages.

scripts.build: bun build src/backend.ts --outfile dist/backend.js --target bun && bun build src/frontend.ts --outfile dist/frontend.js --target browser
scripts.build:tsc: tsc src/backend.ts --target es2022 --module es2022 --moduleResolution bundler --outDir dist --skipLibCheck && tsc src/frontend.ts --target es2022 --module es2022 --moduleResolution bundler --lib es2022,dom --outDir dist --skipLibCheck
